response.sql: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as player_total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(player_total) as avg_val FROM player_totals), above_avg_players AS (SELECT player_total FROM player_totals WHERE player_total > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_calc)) SELECT SUM(player_total) as sum_of_totals, AVG(player_total - (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_calc)) as avg_excess FROM above_avg_players
